# 灵桥 · Linkora

**Multi-platform AI Intelligent Connection Hub**

Unified access to DingTalk (钉钉) / Feishu (飞书) / WeCom (企业微信), integrating a RAG knowledge base, a rule engine, LLM dialogue, and a web admin console

## Project Overview

**灵桥（Linkora）** brings an enterprise-grade AI assistant into teams' daily IM tools (DingTalk / Feishu / WeCom). An AI avatar that 'can understand enterprise knowledge, call tools, and be manually reviewed' appears directly in the group chats and direct messages you already use.

A typical flow: a message comes in → rule / intent routing → hits the knowledge base or calls a tool → LLM generates a reply → the reply is sent back along the same path. The whole process can be viewed, adjusted, and approved in the web admin console. The three platforms each have their own adapter, database, and poller. Data is physically isolated, and each platform can be started and stopped independently.

| Dimension | Scale (measured from current code) |
| --- | --- |
| Integrated platforms | **3** (DingTalk / Feishu / WeCom, with physically isolated data) |
| Built-in tools | **49** (Tool Calling, single source of truth: `BUILTIN_TOOL_MANIFEST`) |
| Intent classification | **41** (9 dispositions + 7 actions + 25 domains) |
| Web admin console | **20 pages (SPA)** / 36 route modules / 196 endpoints (counted by HTTP method) |
| Code size | 242 `src` Python modules / 320 test files / 4954 Python test cases / 182 frontend test cases |

1zzzzzlll/GrowQuizLauncher.body:
---

## What is this

Kids want to watch one more episode, and parents can't always be right beside them.

**宝贝成长桌面 (Baby Growth Desktop)** replaces the Android TV home screen with a small, fast launcher. At the interval you set, it brings a full-screen quiz to the front. Answer wrong and you get another question to keep going. Answer right and you return to the home screen. All questions are built in and work offline. The volume and back keys can't get past the quiz into cartoons. If you want to keep watching, answer one question correctly first.

The same package also works on phones and tablets. There it can serve only as a 'scheduled quiz + parental management console' without taking over the home screen. To make the quiz appear on time, it needs five permissions (overlay, alarms and reminders, unrestricted battery, notifications, and full-screen alerts). You can enable each one under 'Kids Scheduled Quiz → Quiz Guarantee' on the device. No computer is needed.

It is based on the open-source desktop [Plume Launcher](https://github.com/aradhyas8/Plume_Launcher), a minimal TV launcher with no ads, no accounts, and no analytics, with an APK of about 0.4 MB. While keeping all of the original launcher's features, it adds kids' quiz and parental management modules. The Baby Growth Desktop package itself is about 1.0 MB.

## Core features

| | Feature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| ⏱ | **Scheduled full-screen quiz** | Automatically pops up a quiz at the set interval (1 minute to 24 hours), takes over the foreground, and displays full screen |
| 🔁 | **Wrong answer gives a new question, right answer returns** | A wrong answer only swaps in another question and offers no 'exit'. After a correct answer, it returns to the playback page and restarts the timer |
| 🧠 | **33,000 offline questions** | Eleven age groups from 5 to 15, with 3,000 questions per group, covering 12 categories such as math, Chinese language, science, and history. No network or login required |
| 🗂 | **Multi-select category drawing** | Parents can select multiple categories to limit the question pool (for example, only math and English). If none are selected, all categories are used. The console shows the number of questions per category for each age, and categories with no questions for that age are grayed out and cannot be selected |
| 📥 | **Bulk question bank import** | The console includes an AI question-writing tutorial and prompt templates. Upload a question bank file (JSON) generated in bulk by AI. Each question is validated, duplicates are skipped, and the rest are added and shuffled together with the built-in questions |
| 🛠 | **Question bank maintenance** | In the console, filter questions by age, category, or status, and disable or enable them in bulk. A question answered correctly 5 times is automatically 'retired' and no longer appears |
| 🔊 | **Read-aloud questions** | Questions are read aloud only for ages 10 and under. From age 11, kids read the screen themselves. Symbols, brackets, fractions, and units are converted into readable words. Options that are a single character, digit, or letter (or a string of English letters) are not read aloud, since reading them would give away the answer. Playback stops immediately when the screen turns off or the app goes to the background, and resumes when the quiz page returns to the foreground. If the TV has no speech engine, you can load built-in speech from 'Environment Check' without installing any software |
| ⏳ | **Think before answering** | For a few seconds after a question appears, the options are disabled and a countdown is shown on screen. This prevents instant random tapping. The default is 5 seconds, adjustable from 0 to 60 seconds in the admin console |

Upstream Canta works as: select an app → tap the trash can → uninstall. # AI Price Memory

An open-source public price aggregation platform for AI subscription products. The project discovers products from public storefronts, performs standardization, classification, inventory and price updates, and provides price comparison through web catalogs with verifiable sources.

**Online site: [https://ai.pricememo.cn/](https://ai.pricememo.cn/)**

> This project is not an official website of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, or any third-party storefront, and it does not handle transactions, payment collection, delivery, or after-sales service.

## Features

- Aggregates public price quotes for ChatGPT, Codex, OpenAI API, Claude, Gemini, Grok, X Premium, and other products
- Distinguishes real account plans by brand and maintains tiers separately, such as Claude Pro / Max, Google AI, Cursor, and Grok; subscriptions without a clearly stated tier are displayed separately
- Includes email, SMS code / verification, virtual cards, gift cards, social media accounts, Apple ID, and VPS; see [auxiliary product catalog](https://github.com/BeterXie/ai_price_radar/blob/HEAD/docs/AUXILIARY_CATALOG.md)
- Displays original product titles, categories, descriptions, inventory, prices, delivery methods, update times, and source links
- Filtering by combinations of brand, account plan, and source platform; keyword search supports multi-word intersection across titles, brands, and storefronts, and persists through details and pagination
- Standard products use clean URLs and reuse a unified catalog workspace; quotes load through a real paginated waterfall feed
- Distinguishes delivery forms and uses only directly comparable quotes to calculate the primary lowest price, while retaining the lowest prices of all related products
- Generates a same-product fingerprint from title, description summary, delivery form, period, and warranty, and aggregates duplicate cross-store entries by default
- Original long descriptions are loaded on demand after quotes are expanded; the first screen returns only a purchase-decision summary
- LDXP, reviewed Dujiao-Next, and merchant feeds switch atomically through the same complete snapshot; if any source fails, the previous online catalog is retained
- Records quote history and retains manual review, hiding, and reclassification states
- Automatic storefront discovery, periodic scanning, SQLite validation, snapshots, and idempotent PostgreSQL sync
- Provides report and correction features and a basic admin backend that is not publicly exposed
- The admin backend can configure ads and relay station directories, and supports relay station application review, encrypted detection keys, real model liveness probing, and sampling statistics for the last 24 hours
- Provides a dynamic Sitemap, self-referencing canonical URLs, structured product data, unique product descriptions, and social share images
- Provides official price references, data quality checks, source scan health, aggregate trends, a browser-local watchlist, and Atom Feed
- Supports public correction records, merchant responses, and LDXP and generic merchant JSON Feed connectors

# 🌟 Stella

**A QQ group chat bot that chats in a human-like way, driven by a memory system**

*— Designed for an 8K context window, compatible with both local small models and online APIs*

Chinese | [English](https://github.com/Enoa-devteam/Stella_project/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

---

Stella doesn't just throw messages at a large model and return a single reply. It **distills scattered information from group chats into memories that are retrievable, verifiable, and forgettable**, and proactively asks about you at the right moments.

Stella is designed around a very small context window, with a baseline limit of **8192 tokens**. Persona, memory, conversation history, and tool results must coexist within this tight budget, which is impossible to achieve by simply stuffing more into the prompt. So the budget is split up: memories are filtered in the database before being injected, tools run outside the chat context and only return a single conclusion, and conversation that scrolls out of the window is automatically compressed into a recap. **No matter how many plugins are installed, they don't take up the conversation window.** A small window works, and a large window naturally gives more room. The reverse doesn't hold, though: an architecture that assumes an unlimited window will spiral out of control at 8K.

You decide where the models come from.
- **Fully local**: Chat runs on a model on the GPU, and memory consolidation runs on a small model on the CPU. They don't compete for resources, and no group chat content leaves your machine.
- **Fully online**: Connect any OpenAI-compatible API and it runs without a graphics card.
- **Hybrid**: Hand dialogue generation to an online model, keep high-frequency, low-difficulty tasks like memory consolidation and session compression local, and send only the step that needs strong reasoning over the network.

> Note: In fully local mode, data never leaves the machine. Tools that need network access (checking the weather, checking anime schedules) send their own requests and return the actual data, while deciding whether to use a tool, compressing results into summaries, and rendering plugin cards into images all happen locally.

# 📚 搜书吧助手

## ✨ Introduction

An adapter plugin for [**AstrBot**](https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot) designed for 搜书吧. It helps users quickly get the latest usable links for 搜书吧 and similar sites, and supports keyword search, downloads, and monitoring of forum availability.

---

## 🚀 Features

- **Multi-site support**: 搜书吧, SXSY, 第一会所, 第一版主, 有爱爱.
- **Smart navigation**: automatically parses usable real URLs from navigation entries and randomly returns one of several candidates.
- **In-site search**: supports keyword search on 搜书吧 and SXSY.
- **Direct download**: supports starting an attachment download directly by passing a post number as a parameter.
- **Automatic re-archiving**: if sending a file fails, it is automatically packed into a ZIP and resent. An encryption password can be configured.
- **Quota control**: supports daily limits on the coin quota per user or globally (admins are not restricted).
- **Status monitoring**: supports per-session subscriptions to monitoring notifications. Successes send no notification, failures trigger an alert, and recovery sends a notification.

---

## 📖 Usage

After the plugin is loaded, the following commands are available:

### 1. 搜书吧

- `/ssb` or `/搜书吧`: get the latest 搜书吧 address.
- `/ssb <关键词>`: search for books on 搜书吧.
- `/ssb <序号>`: select the corresponding post from the previous search results and automatically download its single attachment.
- `/ssb <帖子URL>`: directly parse and download the attachments of that post.

> **Note**
>
> `/ssb <关键词>` requires configuring `账号密码` (format: `账号&密码`).

### 2. SXSY

- Same usage as `/ssb`.

> **Note**
>
> `/sxsy <关键词>` requires configuring `网站地址` and `Cookie` (the site address used for search and status monitoring).

### 3. Attachment Download

- `/下书 <序号>`: download the pending attachments; `/下书 0` downloads all of them.
- Only applies to the **most recent** post whose attachment list was shown. The site is detected automatically.

### 4. Other Sites

- `/sis` or `/第一会所`: get the latest 第一会所 address.
- `/01bz` or `/第一版主`: get the latest 第一版主 address.
- `/uaa` or `/有爱爱`: get the latest 有爱爱 address.
- `/jm` or `/禁漫天堂`: get the latest 禁漫天堂 address and APP download address.

### 5. Site Status Monitoring (Admins)

- `/ssbmon` or `/监控搜书吧`: subscribe to 搜书吧 status notifications in the current session.
- `/ssbmon off`: unsubscribe from 搜书吧 status notifications in the current session.
- `/sxsymon` or `/监控SXSY`: subscribe to SXSY status notifications in the current session.
- `/sxsymon off`: unsubscribe from SXSY status notifications in the current session.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

After the first load, go to the plugins page in the AstrBot dashboard and find this plugin to configure it. All configuration items include detailed descriptions and hints.

A full-process STM32 tool layer, distributed as a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): 37 tools, 7 slash commands, and 1 bundled SKILL. [Simplified Chinese](https://github.com/Lianzy-Baimiao/FluentCal/blob/HEAD/README.md) · [Traditional Chinese](https://github.com/Lianzy-Baimiao/FluentCal/blob/HEAD/README.zh-TW.md) · [English](https://github.com/Lianzy-Baimiao/FluentCal/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

FluentCal is a native Windows desktop calendar and Gantt chart. Tasks, calendars, and project plans share one dataset. It works offline, requires no account, and has no ads.

[Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9NTT06453DG5?cid=DevShareMCLPCB) · [Windows installer](https://github.com/Lianzy-Baimiao/FluentCal/releases/latest) · [Android client](https://github.com/Lianzy-Baimiao/FluentCal/releases/tag/android-latest)

## Screenshots

The following shows the Simplified Chinese interface.

Read-only web view in a mobile browser:

## Features

- **Calendar and to-dos**: month view, multi-week view, and list view; lunar calendar, solar terms, festivals, and public holidays; recurring tasks and undated to-dos.
- **Gantt chart**: drag to schedule, adjust progress, view groups and dependencies, export PNG/SVG.
- **Search and groups**: filter by group, optional list labels; recent changes support undo.
- **Countdown**: new installs show manually marked items and regular festivals by default. Public holidays, solar terms, and task groups can be selected individually; multi-day holidays count down from the first day.
- **Appearance**: light, dark, or follow system; custom background, text, and task colors and opacity; adjustable font and text outline.
- **Cross-device**: optional sync via WebDAV, GitHub, or Gitee. Web view is read-only and can be opened locally or on the LAN; Android supports offline editing, Gantt chart, and reminders.

Cloud sync, web view, and AI assistant connections are off by default and only run once enabled.

## Download

Install the Windows version from the [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9NTT06453DG5?cid=DevShareMCLPCB) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Lianzy-Baimiao/FluentCal/releases/latest). Overwrite upgrades keep your data. Requires Windows 10 1809 or later, x64.

SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-no-workspace.description: DSH no-workspace plugin: start chatting without picking a workspace; standalone conversations are listed flat in the sidebar, and the native workspace interface stays unchanged.
SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-no-workspace.body:
# No Workspace for DSH

**Keep conversations independent instead of forcing them into a folder.**

[English](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-no-workspace/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · Simplified Chinese

Adds a true first-class “No Workspace” conversation state to DeepSeek Harness while preserving the native workspace experience.

*Choose “No Workspace” from the workspace selector; even if you then collapse the workspace, standalone conversations still appear directly in the sidebar.*

## What it solves

DSH originally placed every conversation in a workspace, or displayed it in an extra “Ungrouped” folder. This plugin makes “unbound from a workspace” a true first-class state: standalone conversations appear directly in the sidebar, no fictitious “Ungrouped” directory is shown, and they do not quietly inherit the current workspace.

| Scenario | After installation |
| --- | --- |
| Click “New conversation” at the top | Creates a standalone conversation without inheriting the current or most recently used workspace |
| Choose “No Workspace” in the workspace selector | Losslessly moves the current conversation out of the workspace |
| Collapse a real workspace | Standalone conversations still appear as top-level conversations |
| Open a standalone blank conversation | Input, model selection, attachments, and sending are available immediately |
| Use native workspace features | Search, menus, drag and drop, sorting, archiving, and directory selection remain unchanged |

## Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-no-workspace
```

Install from a local source directory or a packaged file:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-no-workspace
# or
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-no-workspace-1.5.5.tgz
```

Restart DSH after installing or upgrading so that both host-side and client-side code reload.

## Design principles

- **Does not replace the native sidebar**: the plugin adapts the shared new-conversation action, preserving native components and shortcut dispatch.
- **Does not fake folders**: it only hides the “Ungrouped” container around standalone conversations, and separates them from the workspaces above with a 「无工作区」 / “No Workspace” heading and spacing that match the native style. Conversation rows keep the native status slot, so the titles of blank, populated, and running conversations stay aligned.
- **Does not damage history**: unbinding only updates the workspace conversation index, fully preserving conversation events, drafts, and context.
- **Does not pollute the execution directory**: new standalone conversations use the user's home directory as a neutral execution directory.
- **Does not break the language experience**: the interface displays 「无工作区」 or “No Workspace” depending on DSH's display language.

# dsh-plugin-smooth-stream

Simplified Chinese | [English](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-smooth-stream/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

Replaces the character-by-character jittery streaming output with a reading experience that reveals content in paragraph batches with a fade-in. During streaming, the page smoothly follows the scroll; thinking blocks show a live single-line summary.

**Left: DSH native rendering · Right: Smooth Stream** — the same question, started at the same time:

## Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-smooth-stream
```

Open any session to take effect. Settings entry: Settings panel → **Smooth Stream**.

## What It Changes

- **Paragraph-based reveal** — Replies no longer pop in one character at a time; instead, a full paragraph accumulates and then fades in as a whole. When splitting, it automatically avoids unfinished code blocks and tables, so Markdown is never rendered halfway.
- **Smooth scrolling** — During streaming, the page scrolls steadily toward the bottom, so long replies don't jump abruptly. Scrolling up hands control back to you, and scrolling back to the bottom resumes automatic following.
- **Thinking summary** — While the model is thinking, the latest sentence scrolls in real time within the collapsed line, with fade-out at both ends. When the turn ends, the underline slowly retracts, signaling "done thinking."
- **Markdown and formulas** — The body uses DSH's built-in renderer: code highlighting, copy buttons, tables, and KaTeX formulas are all identical to the native ones.

## Settings

The **Smooth Stream** section in the settings panel. Changes take effect immediately and are saved persistently:

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Enable Smooth Stream | On | When turned off, DSH's built-in rendering is restored immediately, for easy comparison |
| Entrance animation | Fade | Fade / Rise / Dissolve / Wipe / Focus / Glow / Iris / Soak |
| Animation duration | 520 ms | Duration of the entrance animation (120–1200 ms) |
| Batch size | 500 characters | How much text accumulates before a batch is revealed; smaller is more "real-time," larger is quieter |
| Smooth scroll-follow | On | Smooth scroll-follow during streaming |

Includes a live preview and a one-click restore to defaults. The settings UI follows DSH's display language.

Eight entrance animations, each with its default timing tuned to its style; all are recorded below using the same reply for direct comparison.

## Project Purpose
- Add Wear Compose crown haptic vibration support for Xiaomi / OPPO watches
- Fix the `ClassNotFoundException` crashes on Xiaomi watches caused by the missing `com.google.wear.input.WearHapticFeedbackConstants`
- Fix abnormal haptic sensations on some Xiaomi watches caused by modified haptic feedback constants `CLOCK_TICK` / `SEGMENT_FREQUENT_TICK`

>
> This project is still in an early stage and currently only supports the Xiaomi Watch 5 series, the OPPO Watch all-smart series, and their newer products. Other devices are yet to be adapted, and compatibility is unverified.

- [ ] Mitigate `ClassNotFoundException` and `NoClassDefFoundError` crashes caused by calling private classes on devices without Google's private libraries
- [ ] Create a crown rate normalization factor to unify crown scrolling speed across different devices as much as possible
- [ ] Support Android-based Huawei watch devices

The project offers two integration methods: use the **Gradle plugin** when you can modify the app's source code; use the **Xposed module** when you need to install hooks inside the app process. a775828b-dot/xtier.body:
# XTier

[English](https://github.com/a775828b-dot/xtier/blob/HEAD/docs/README.en.md) · [Documentation index](https://github.com/a775828b-dot/xtier/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md) · [Quick start](https://github.com/a775828b-dot/xtier/blob/HEAD/docs/quickstart.md) · [Support status](https://github.com/a775828b-dot/xtier/blob/HEAD/docs/support.md)

XTier is a plugin for the official [SGLang](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang) (tracking the main branch) that performs CPU/GPU tiered MoE inference. Experts are spread across two tiers, VRAM and system memory, placed by heat and scheduled on demand. NVMe only holds the rows of embedding tables (DeepSeek's Engram, Qwen's PLE). When memory cannot hold all the experts, an optional cold expert pool moves rarely used experts to disk and reads them back into memory when needed. The pool's size and speed are limited by the disk's speed and type.

**Status: early development** ([work plan](https://github.com/a775828b-dot/xtier/blob/HEAD/docs/PLAN.md)). Qwen3.8 Flash Next, GLM-5.3 Flash, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 run on SGLang main. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash runs on SGLang's M3.1 branch (PR #45925), and its development is paused (too slow on this machine, and limited model quality).

- **No changes to SGLang source code**: it only uses hooks from the official plugin framework, attached to the entry point of the official KTransformers hybrid inference, and self-checks after loading whether it has taken over successfully.
- **Model-agnostic**: the hybrid inference wraps the official `FusedMoE` quantization method, so any model with standard MoE layers can run it out of the box (NVFP4, MXFP4 experts).
- **Optional acceleration packs**: model-specific fixes and kernels live under `xtier/packs/`.

Meridian is a multi-site reverse proxy and node scheduling panel for Emby and Jellyfin. It puts site entry points, backup routes, playback address rewriting, traffic statistics, request logs, watch history, TLS, and an optional edge Agent into a single control panel.

For the official installation version and checksum files, refer to the [latest GitHub Release](https://github.com/chanhui800/Meridian/releases/latest). Node scheduling is enabled per site; sites that are not enabled continue to use the original panel entry.

In July 2017, I chose iOS developer as my third career. Before that, I worked as a reporter at a magazine in 2015, and in 2016 I worked in the Philippines. The world I experienced in jobs far removed from software felt non-deterministic and irrational to me. There were many reasons for leaving that life and choosing a different career. When I share soju glasses with friends, I often hear that if I had kept doing the work of 2015 and 2016, I would have ended my life by jumping from a building. I still don't know whether they're right.

HeavyMach is also one of the reasons I left the life of 2015 and 2016 and chose a different career. As a college student, I met this game on my iPod touch. I first encountered it through Cydia, and later I bought it by searching for how to create a US Apple App Store account, because the Korean App Store had no game category at the time. I tilted the device to move and fire the tank, and when a stage was finished, an illustration appeared. I think this game had about a 35% influence on my decision to change careers to development.

These days I feel that I don't have much time left. It's not because of health problems, nor because of extreme lethargy. One of the things I chose is restoring HeavyMach: making the game that once showed me a direction work again, now that I am a developer. There was a person named [mesabloo](https://github.com/Mesabloo/hm-defense) who worked on a similar project. He obtained the assets of HeavyMach Defense and wrote the source code from scratch. - 💬 **Chat**: QQ-style private and group chats, with red envelopes, transfers, pats, voice messages, and shared songs. You can open several chat windows with the same person. The wallet and shop let you buy bubbles, pendants, backgrounds, and gifts to give to characters, and characters will also give you things. When you finish chatting, you can 'bring it into the story,' and the next passage of narrative will pick it up.
- 📞 **Calls**: Characters call you using their own voice, with subtitles on screen. You reply by typing. Missed calls become missed-call entries, and they leave voicemail.
- 🌸 **Moments** and 🗨️ **Forum**: Characters post updates and like and comment on each other's. The forum has trending topics, and characters and passersby (netizens) post and reply in threads. Your posts also get replies.

- 📨 **Narrative and Phone**: Manage two directions from one panel. Messages in the narrative are actually delivered to the phone, and you can choose several phone chat messages to bring into the narrative, or have the narrative keep remembering them.

Also includes a dialogue mini-window, sentence-by-sentence 'listen' playback, and 'full read-aloud' that reads narration along with the dialogue.

- 🎬 **Visual Novel**: Present the narrative as a galgame: backgrounds, character sprites, dialogue boxes, and voice, one line at a time. Sprites change expressions and perform actions to match emotion, and rain, snow, lightning, and flashbacks in the narration get staged effects.

hinshiba/PlusPim.body:
# PlusPim

A DAP-compatible MIPS assembly language debugger

## Overview

PlusPim is a debugging tool for MIPS assembly code that supports the Debug Adapter Protocol. By combining a backend written in `.NET` with a frontend VS Code extension, it provides a convenient debugging experience.

This project consists mainly of two parts:
1. **PlusPim**: A `.NET 11` application that implements the [Debug Adapter Protocol (DAP)](https://microsoft.github.io/debug-adapter-protocol/) and handles MIPS emulation and debugging logic.
2. **VS Code extension**: An extension that integrates the debugger into VS Code and provides the user interface for debugging commands.

It is a so-called time-travel debugger and supports backward stepping.

## Features

- **Step execution**: Executes MIPS code one line (or one instruction) at a time.
- **Backward step execution**: Reverts MIPS code to the state one line earlier.
- **Pause**: Pauses a running program.
- **Register display**: Shows the state of all 32 MIPS registers during execution.
- **Breakpoints**: Allows breakpoints to be set.
- **Label resolution**: Parses and resolves labels used for jumps and branches.
- **Exception emulation**: Jumps to the kernel text segment and runs the handler.
- **Multi-file support**: Supports order-independent linking.
- **Memory view**: Lets you view the data region.
- **Pseudo-instruction expansion display**: Shows the machine instructions that pseudo-instructions expand into (displayed as inlay hints in VS Code).
